_about: One row per scheme in data-source/Maharashtra_Linguistic_Minority_wise_Schemes.docx. 'src' is the exact text of the Word file (checked by tools/build-linguistic-data.py). 'en' = English name (the English in brackets in the Word file when it has one, otherwise a plain translation). 'mr' = Marathi name (the Word file's own Marathi when it has one, otherwise a translation). 'hi' = Hindi name (always a translation). 'sec' = the group the scheme is shown in. English / Marathi / Hindi wording written by the developer: please have a native speaker confirm it.
